findings.evidence: `Open project settings` leads to a form pre-filled with `value="Customer Migration"`

findings.fix: Add visible text (e.g., "Duplicate") or an icon element inside the button so its purpose is visible, not just accessible.
findings.violation: The button has no visible text or icon content, so sighted users see a blank, unlabeled control even though it has an aria-label for screen readers.
